newsitem.title: USA: Ashland says Providence withdraws nomination.
newsitem.headline: Ashland says Providence withdraws nomination.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Monday that Providence Capital, which had proposed nominating three directors to Ashland's board, agreed to withdraw its nominations.

A Providence Capital executive said in an Ashland release Monday that it is "in the best interest of Ashland's shareholders to give Ashland's new chief executive officer some time for implementation."
Providence Capital had proposed to nominate the three directors to Ashland's board at its annual shareholders' meeting which will still be held January 30, 1997, in Russell, Kentucky.

Ashland said that in connection with the agreement by Providence Capital to withdraw its nominations, Ashland would reimburse Providence for certain of its out-of-pocket expenses not to exceed $75,000.
Ashland said that shareholders of record on November 25, 1996, will be entitled to vote at the meeting.
